dialogues.speaker: Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Feiyun Slope Bulletin Board. You can find community news and shop advertisements posted here. Please do not post unimportant matters.

dialogues.speaker: Wanwen Bookhouse Ad
dialogues.text: Thousands of books and centuries of thought converge on the humble shelves of Wanwen Bookhouse. Fellow book-lovers are welcome to come peruse and purchase any literature they may fancy!

dialogues.speaker: Wanwen Bookhouse Ad
dialogues.text: The books in this store are collectibles and may be damaged if handled carelessly. Must purchase before reading.

dialogues.speaker: Wanwen Bookhouse Ad
dialogues.text: Top Sellers: Legend of the Shattered Halberd, Heart's Desire, Legend of the Lone Sword

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "May I ask if you have any copies of Legend of the Shattered Halberd - The Final Chapter of the Star Capital?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Apologies, but I do not sell unofficial canon not authorized by the original author."
